this is set of 3 unique maps served as demo/introduction to main game titled Age of Defense (AoD). Note: this review is about AoD:Prehistory, not full game. (Tbh i dont know what to think about this release, development od AoD took like 4? years more than planned. Game should not have bugs at this point, and i hit one error and one screen display issue/glitch with random, unremovable bar visible on bottom of screen - i have same issue with full AoD) if you played a lot od TDs, and i consider myself as a grounded person in this genre, you will have a feeling that this game is a bit unbalanced, i mean there are no power spikes that you get during level, when you could feel that your setup really works and you can relax for a while, you receive just enough resources to clear map and achieve requirements from clay tablets but to achieve this you need to get through level at least twice, one to learn waves, patterns etc which is 30 mins on average. IF you make a mistake, you will spend resources incorrectly or missplace tower, you can restart. What i was also missing (dunno if its only demo) is some kind of bestiary filled in after each level with speed/resistances/special abilities monsters are using (there are some, like slowing, shileding, healing itself or disabling tower at all). Range of towers is weird, a lot of times tower can attack target way outside its circled range, not that i complain about this, but its bit weird. Also after upgrading tower it takes too long to reinitiate attack. i really would appreciate some key shortcuts for traps, palisades and meteor, as youre using it a lot and cap is set for 9 traps and 4 palisades, some 1/2/3 or q/w/e would work (if there is, i couldnt find it). I couldnt find a way to sell/salvage towers, if you missplace something, you have a problem. (maybe some of problems are due to bar on bottom that i mentioned at beginning and im missing part of interface, nontheless, it is for me as it is) What is really great is of course audio and video part, a lot of details, cool animations, quite interesting "cave/tribal" approach in descriptions etc, on top of this game works very fliud and sounds are refreshing. Also development team is super responsive and they care for sure about their products. After demo i would go with mixed, as i was more stressed due to this unbalance than felt enjoyment playing this, maybe with some upgrade tree, which from what i investigated is part of main game it feels different.
It's a mid TD game, very few towers, the maps cut off placement, the sound bugs out very easy. It's just mid for a free demo that doesn't really sell the main game.

"Age of Defense: Prehistory" is not a game. It's an advertisement for a product called "Age of Defense". Age of Defense is a weak Russian ripoff of Kingdom Rush but with much worse gameplay and a caveman/vodka/alcoholism theme that somehow never got published on the app stores where it belongs. It's from known Russian asset flippers/shovelware pushers at Valkyrie Initiative, most commonly known for paying the old Russian review farm for fake reviews on their garbage products. It's strange to see fake reviews on an advertisement, but that's what's going on here. But this isn't completely relevant because this is not Age of Defense, it's just an advertisment for it, so it's not correct to try to review that completely distinct product. We must instead review this for what it is... an advertisement. If you enjoy advertisements, you can consume them for free on the web or on Youtube without needing to add them to your game library, download them, and then launch the advertising. It's impossible in a general sense to recommend people should do that over playing real, full games on Steam, and that applies here with "Age of Defense: Prehistory" too. The objective of this short advertisement is to get you to fork out a whopping $15 USD to the Russian shovelware pushers who polluted Steam with this trash, so you can unlock the full game. I don't recommend you do. This is only free in the same way that adverts on Youtube and banner ads in your browser are. This is a game demo that's been dumped on Steam to advertise another Steam store page in the hopes of raking in some cash. Just because advertisements are free, doesn't mean they're worth your time. It's important to understand there's a formal process to create a demo/page for a game which hasn't been followed here: https://partner.steamgames.com/doc/store/application/demos While it might seem like an inocuous mistake, publishing demos and advertisements as if they are full games is misleading and in some ways harmful. This advertisement is taking up marketing space and visibility that would be better made available to a developer that's done the right thing and created a full game. Instead, that visibility is given over to a demo/advert that's been published incorrectly and is polluting the marketplace. It's unclear if this mistake was made through incompetence or a deliberate intent to mislead gamers. Often developers may choose to incorrectly publish demo/advertisements as separate games as a cheap way to bypass paying Valve for marketing presence on the Steam front page, which may seem clever to them, but it's harmful behaviour and it's not good for gamers. [quote][b][url=https://www.ftc.gov/legal-library/browse/federal-register-notices/16-cfr-part-465-trade-regulation-rule-use-consumer-reviews-testimonials-final-rule]Warning: Review Manipulation![/url][/b] This advertisement features a number of fake positive reviews from accounts known to be in the business of review manipulation/paid reviews. They're all written in either Russian or broken English, appear at almost exactly the same time, very shortly after the game launched on Steam, and the accounts are used consistently to write fake reviews for asset flips and other cash grabs/scams. The "Positive" review score on this game should be disregarded due to this blatant, unethical review manipulation. This is done to deceive and scam gamers into paying for a bad product. Due to the 2024 FTC ruling (16 CFR Part 465), these fake reviews are a violation of US Federal Law.[/quote] Advertisements and incorrectly published demos don't add +1 to your game collector count, they aren't full games. It's impossible for me to recommend this incorrectly published advertising spam to gamers, you deserve better than adverts.

评分：4/5 评测：各方面比较像《王国保卫战》，史前石器时代主题。炮塔有“弓箭手”“投石手”“法师”“孵蛋师”四种，前三种比较常见，“孵蛋师”是提升最大炮塔数量用的，后期炮塔的上限需要用蛋来提升，此外还有三个小技能也可以用。这个游戏最大的特色就是地图中的全部位置都可以建造炮塔，没有建设点，只要有空间就可以往里塞，到后期满屏炮塔看着还是挺爽的。序章一共有3关，每关半个小时左右，可玩性也不错。推荐
挺好玩的，就是没有图鉴说明，不知道自己的塔是什么效果，地图相对单调，优化也一般，不过挺有特色，如果打磨的细点，还是不错的一款游戏
